maria_zephyr: Posting a customer repro — invoice shows ~3.2k tokens but SDK estimator returns ~2.1k. Customer used node SDK v1.4.2.

alex_support: Can you paste the minimal curl and the SDK call you used?

maria_zephyr: Sure. curl we used (redacted keys):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-quant","input":"Summarize...","max_tokens":256}'
```

SDK (node):
```
const r = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.SK});
await r.generate({model: 'redwood-large-quant', input: 'Summarize...', max_tokens: 256});
```
Response headers included x-request-id: rq_01H... and server reported tokens: prompt=920, completion=2300, total=3220.

sam_billing: :eyes: can you attach invoice lines and approximate timeframe? We need request id to correlate metering logs.

maria_zephyr: Invoice id INV-2026-03-09-1234. Request id rq_01Habc123. Time ~2026-03-09T14:12:22Z. Customer also had tool calls enabled; they call a retrieval tool in-system.

jordan_eng_oncall: Two likely possibilities: (1) Server-side preamble/tool messages added to the prompt (hidden system messages or function call scaffolding), or (2) Streaming termination added hidden tokens on finalization. We saw a runtime change last week that appends a small diagnostics footer when tool calls are enabled.

deploy-bot: Deployed runtime v2.9.1 -> added `diagnostic_footer` injection for tool sessions (opt-out flag: `no_diagnostic_footer`).

alex_support: Can you repro with curl and add header `x-redwood-debug: dump-token-breakdown`? That will log token breakdown to the metering trace and return a short token report in response metadata.

maria_zephyr: Repro attached (curl with header). The response now contains `x-token-breakdown: prompt=1205, system=150, tool=760, completion=2300, total=4415`. SDK estimator still reports ~2100. So system+tool are missing from client-side estimator.

jordan_eng_oncall: Confirmed root cause: node SDK estimator uses client-visible input + predicted completion and does not account for server-side system messages and tool scaffolding injected by runtime when toolcalls are enabled. Fix options: (A) update SDK estimator to request a preflight token count from server, (B) ensure runtime only counts tokens that are billable and expose them via response header, (C) add opt-out flag `no_diagnostic_footer` to runtime (deploy-bot already mentioned flag).

sam_billing: For this customer we should issue a billing credit for the delta between their estimate and invoice for the affected window while we roll out mitigations. I'll start a credit request; need final metering doc from eng.

alex_support: Next steps for support: 1) Share the x-token-breakdown for rq_01Habc123 in the ticket. 2) Ask customer to pass `no_diagnostic_footer` or disable toolcalls temporarily. 3) We'll follow up with SDK team to patch estimator.

maria_zephyr: Thanks — I updated the ticket with the breakdown and suggested workaround. Customer is ok with temporary opt-out while you patch the SDK.

jordan_eng_oncall: Filing follow-up issue: SDK-3912 (estimator: include server-injected messages or request server preflight). Assigning to @alex_support and @sdk-team. I'll attach traces.

alex_support: ack :white_check_mark: I'll coordinate the SDK PR and post a status update here.
